name: box-least-squares
title: box-least-squares
description: Box Least Squares (BLS) periodogram for detecting transiting exoplanets and eclipsing binaries. Use when searching for periodic box-shaped dips in light curves. Alternative to Transit Least Squares, available in astropy.timeseries. Based on Kovács et al. (2002).

related_skills.name: transit-least-squares
related_skills.reason: Both detect transiting exoplanets from light curves using specialized transit-search periodograms with same output type.

related_skills.name: exoplanet-workflows
related_skills.reason: BLS is a specific detection method within broader exoplanet analysis workflows and best practices.
